note: The gate that guards novelty must itself be measured. KNOWN side: real textbook claims that MUST score 'known' (external ground truth — catches an over-permissive gate letting textbook biology through as novel). NOVEL side: seeded at runtime from the genuine store's own questions (regression — catches threshold drift that would kill verified findings). Hand-authoring 'novel' claims is deliberately avoided: we cannot know a hand-written claim is absent from PubMed, but we know the store's claims passed Gate-2 and replicated.
